financials_interim.notes: Same source as GROUP row (source_id 52507), 'COMPANY' column of the same statements (see GROUP row's notes for the shared basis-labelling explanation, FX-gain driver, sub-division/EPS cross-check, and CF reconstruction methodology -- all apply identically here since KCAB's Company and Company-and-Investee P&L, CF and Revenue/Cost lines are nearly identical, differing only by the tiny equity-pickup line). Profit before tax 848,127k vs 919,270k PY (-7.7%); Profit for the quarter 648,002k vs 658,696k PY (-1.6%) -- both effectively identical to the Group basis (the associate contributes only a net Rs153k/Rs-163k swing). EPS 2.97 vs 3.02, same as Group (single share count, no separate Company EPS distinction in substance). Balance sheet differs from GROUP only in the 'Investment in equity accounted investee' line (51,200k here vs 82,457k on the Company-and-Investee column, doc p.3) and the consequent small difference in Total Assets (18,996,266k vs 19,027,523k) and Total Equity (15,929,449k vs 15,960,706k); all liability lines are identical between the two columns. short_term_borrowings=764,047k (685,638k interest-bearing + 78,409k overdraft, same combination logic as GROUP row). trade_receivables/trade_payables mapped to the combined 'Trade and other receivables/payables' lines, identical figures to GROUP row.

Source: Kelani Cables PLC interim FS for the 03 months ended 30 Jun 2026 (signed 11 Aug 2026, provisional/unaudited). P&L p.2, Balance Sheet p.3, Statement of Changes in Equity p.4, Cash Flow p.5, Notes p.6. Kelani Cables has NO subsidiaries -- its consolidated-equivalent statement is headed 'COMPANY AND INVESTEE', picking up one equity-accounted associate (ACL-Kelani Magnet Wire (Private) Ltd, doc p.7 corporate info) via a single 'Share of profit/(loss) on equity accounted investee' line. This 'Company and Investee' column is stored as basis=GROUP (the closest fit to the schema's Group/Company split), while the pure standalone 'Company' column is basis=COMPANY -- flagged since the label difference from the norm ('Group') could otherwise cause confusion. Revenue 4,939,800k vs 4,554,484k PY (+8.5%); Cost of sales rose faster, 4,108,682k vs 3,479,407k (+18.1%), compressing gross margin from 23.6% to 16.8% -- Gross profit fell 22.7% (831,118k vs 1,075,077k, a Rs 243.96 Mn decline) despite higher revenue, consistent with copper/aluminium input-cost inflation outpacing selling prices. Profit from operations fell 38.8% (463,407k vs 757,069k) after Distribution expenses +17.5% (225,154k vs 191,601k) and Administrative expenses +11.6% (148,358k vs 132,990k) added further drag. PBT fell only 7.7% (848,280k vs 919,107k) because Net finance income more than doubled, +137.2% (384,720k vs 162,201k) -- per Note 5 (doc p.6) this was driven by a large FX gain embedded in finance income: exchange gain/(loss) included in net finance income was Rs 248,181k this quarter vs Rs 41,259k PY (+501.6%), which we identify as the one-off/quasi-one-off item materially cushioning the PBT decline against the operating-margin collapse -- this is an unrealised FX gain on the Company's USD-linked fixed-deposit and financial-asset portfolio (see CF stmt 'Unrealized exchange loss/(gain) on investment in fixed deposits' of 145,386k), not a trading item. PAT fell just 1.6% (648,155k vs 658,533k) as Income tax expense also fell 23.2% (200,125k vs 260,574k), a second partial offset. EPS 2.97 vs 3.02 PY -- both already restated for the 10-for-1 share sub-division approved 18 Dec 2025 (Note 6, doc p.6: 21,800,000 shares -> 218,000,000 shares); cross-check 648,155k/218,000,000=Rs2.973, rounds to 2.97 as disclosed. shares_in_issue=218,000,000 (post-split, current). short_term_borrowings=764,047k combines 'Interest bearing borrowings' current (685,638k) with 'Bank overdrafts' (78,409k) since both are interest-bearing short-term debt -- flagged so the split from the raw 685,638k borrowings-only figure is explicit. long_term_borrowings=11,525k (non-current interest bearing borrowings only; excludes Employee benefits and Deferred taxation, which are not borrowings). cash_and_equivalents=383,451k is the gross Balance Sheet cash figure; the Cash Flow statement's closing cash of 305,043k is this net of the 78,409k bank overdraft (383,451-78,409=305,042, reconciles to within rounding) -- both bases (Company and Investee / Company) share materially identical CF figures because the one-line associate pickup (153k vs -163k adjustment) washes out through the PBT starting point and does not alter subsequent CF totals; hence GROUP and COMPANY rows use the same operating/investing/financing CF figures below. NOTE: the raw PDF-extracted CF statement has line items and their four data columns (C&I-2026, C&I-2025, Company-2026, Company-2025) printed out of visual order in places -- every CF figure used here was independently reconstructed and cross-footed from the underlying adjustment lines (e.g. Net cash used in operating activities = Cash used in operations (2,309,959) - Gratuity paid (1,614) - Current tax paid (227,339) - Interest paid (15,383) = (2,554,295), which matches) rather than trusted from raw column position, per the project's standing instruction to guard against this extraction artifact. capex=(14,980)k (Acquisition of PP&E). trade_receivables mapped to combined 'Trade and other receivables' (2,367,908k) as the closest disclosed line (not split into trade-only vs other); trade_payables similarly mapped to combined 'Trade and other payables' (449,146k) -- both flagged as combined rather than pure-trade figures since KCAB does not disclose the split.
